title: VIVE Flow Controller
body_html:
VR fun is best shared. Pair with VIVE Flow to share the immersive experience between family and friends. Features a 9-axis sensor and intuitively placed touch pad, buttons and trigger for easy maneuvering in VR.

• Optimized control agility with a 9-axis motion sensor.
• Intuitively positioned touch pad, buttons, and trigger for ease of use.
• Just two AAA batteries power the controller up to 30 hours of active use.
*Active use time may vary depending on application.
*Different production batches may have a logo on the Controller for VIVE Flow—and at times no logo—depending on the shipment.
